title: Everyday Essentials
description: High-frequency nouns, verbs and adjectives that show up in every show and card.

words.tip: The kanji looks like a stream with drops splashing off both sides.
A campfire: a central flame with two sparks flying out.

words.sentence: あの[{人|ひと}]は{誰|だれ}ですか。
words.tip: Two legs mid-stride: a person walking.

words.sentence: もう[{時間|じかん}]がない！
words.tip: 時 (time, o'clock) + 間 (interval): the space between moments.
今 (now) + 日 (day/sun). Irregular reading: きょう, not いまひ.
明 (bright: sun + moon) + 日 (day): the next bright day.

words.sentence: {彼|かれ}は{僕|ぼく}の[{友達|ともだち}]だ。

words.tip: A pig (豕) under a roof (宀). Old households kept pigs inside.

words.sentence: {一緒|いっしょ}にラーメンを[{食|た}べよう]。
words.tip: 食 = a lid over a bowl of food.
飲 has 食 (food) on the left and 欠 (a person with a wide-open mouth) on the right.

words.sentence: アニメを[{見|み}る]のが{好|す}きだ。
words.tip: 見 is an eye (目) on legs: an eye walking around to look at things.

words.meaning: to hear, to listen; to ask
words.sentence: {音楽|おんがく}を[{聞|き}いて]いる。
words.tip: An ear (耳) pressed against a gate (門): listening at the door.
Irregular verb: 来る (くる), 来て (きて), 来ない (こない).

words.sentence: {日本語|にほんご}が{少|すこ}し[{分|わ}かる]。
words.tip: 分 = divide (a knife 刀 splitting something). To understand is to break it into pieces you can grasp.
言 = a mouth (口) with words (lines) coming out of it.
待って！ is one of the most common lines in anime.

words.sentence: [{大|おお}きい]{竜|りゅう}が{現|あらわ}れた。
words.tip: 大 is a person spreading their arms wide: 'it was THIS big!'
小 = a tiny hook with two little specks beside it.

words.sentence: [{新|あたら}しい]カードを{買|か}った。
words.tip: 新 has an axe (斤) cutting fresh wood.

words.sentence: この{敵|てき}は[{強|つよ}い]。
words.tip: 強 starts with 弓 (bow): a strong bow.
弱 = two bent bows with drooping feathers: flimsy, weak bows.
早 = the sun (日) rising over a sprout (十): early morning.
本当に？ (really?) is a reaction you'll hear constantly.

words.sentence: あなたの[{名前|なまえ}]は？

words.tip: 世 (generation, society) + 界 (boundary, realm).

words.sentence: その[{気持|きも}ち]は{分|わ}かる。
words.tip: 気 (spirit, energy) + 持ち (holding): the spirit you're holding inside.

words.sentence: ここは{危|あぶ}ない[{場所|ばしょ}]だ。
この{言葉|ことば}の[{意味|いみ}]は{何|なん}ですか。
words.tip: 意 (mind, intention) + 味 (taste): the 'flavor' of an idea.

words.sentence: {君|きみ}の{力|ちから}が[{必要|ひつよう}]だ。
words.tip: 必 (certainly) + 要 (essential).
束 = a bundle of sticks tied together: a promise binds you.

words.translation: I'm at a loss for words.
words.tip: 言 (say) + 葉 (leaves): words are the leaves that grow from speech.

words.sentence: {昔|むかし}のことを[{思|おも}い{出|だ}した]。
words.tip: 思う (think) + 出す (bring out): pull a thought back out.
続 has 糸 (thread): a thread that keeps going.
